notes: Peninsular Spanish (Spain). Patterns with a slot are written with an ellipsis or + slot name in term, and the example always fills the slot. Target words in running English text go in curly quotes “…”. Nouns in term use lemma + article. mesa, menú, camarero and la cuenta are known and can be used freely. Glosses after ' — ' are short English, only when useful.
